intro.title: Che cos'è easyrender?
intro.body: Con easyrender trasformi un'immagine in un modello 3D: carichi la foto di un mobile, di un complemento d'arredo o della facciata di un edificio e ne ricavi un modello 3D. Per prima cosa easyrender disegna l'oggetto da ogni lato in una tavola delle angolazioni gratuita, che controlli prima di spendere un credito. Se ti convince, con un clic ottieni il modello 3D da ruotare e scaricare in GLB e USDZ.
intro.scope: Non modella stanze intere e non inventa misure. Ricevi il file e decidi tu se tenerlo.

connect.q: Cosa vuol dire «collegare il tuo agente»?
connect.a: easyrender è un server MCP. Aggiungilo a Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code o a qualsiasi client MCP con la tua chiave API, e l'agente trasformerà le foto in modelli 3D da solo. Tutto quello che crea compare nella tua dashboard web.

needAgent.q: Mi serve un agente per usarlo?
needAgent.a: No. Puoi caricare le foto nell'app web, una alla volta o in blocco dalla tua libreria. L'agente serve solo a farlo in automatico.

photos.a: Una foto nitida e ben illuminata, con l'oggetto intero e, se possibile, su uno sfondo semplice. Vanno bene le foto di catalogo, le foto prodotto di un solo pezzo o una facciata ben visibile. Sfondi disordinati, oggetti tagliati, foto mosse o dettagli molto fini rendono l'anteprima meno precisa.

scope.a: Mobili, complementi d'arredo e facciate di edifici, partendo da una sola foto. Modella un oggetto alla volta, non stanze intere. Loghi sottili e testi piccoli spesso escono poco definiti.

output.a: Un'anteprima gratuita con l'oggetto da ogni angolazione. Poi, se usi i crediti, un modello 3D da ruotare nella sua pagina e da scaricare come GLB con texture, per il web, e come file USDZ.

freePreview.a: Prima di costruire il modello 3D disegniamo l'oggetto da ogni angolazione. Tu controlli l'anteprima senza costi e usi i crediti solo quando forma e dettagli ti convincono.

failed.q: E se il render non va a buon fine?
failed.a: Se il modello 3D non viene generato, i crediti di quel render ti vengono riaccreditati in automatico.

public.a: I modelli finiti compaiono di default nella galleria pubblica. Nella pagina del modello puoi disattivare «Show in public gallery». Oggi però, se nascondi un modello, il link può smettere di aprirsi per gli altri. Se vuoi condividere il link, lascia il modello nella galleria.

cost.a: L'anteprima è gratis. Un modello 3D finito costa {credits} crediti e ogni credito costa {unit}, quindi un modello costa {price}. I crediti non scadono. Tutti i pacchetti sono nella pagina dei prezzi.

what.a: easyrender è un'app web che trasforma la foto di un oggetto in un modello 3D. Carichi la foto, controlli gratis una tavola con l'oggetto da ogni angolazione e usi i crediti solo se vuoi il modello finito, da scaricare in GLB e USDZ.

formats.a: Due: GLB con texture, per il web e la maggior parte dei programmi 3D, e USDZ, per i dispositivi Apple. Il modello conserva forma e materiali, non le misure reali né la scala.

ar.q: Posso vedere il modello a casa mia?
ar.a: La realtà aumentata è in arrivo: potrai aprire il modello sul telefono e vederlo a casa tua. Mostrerà forma e materiali dell'oggetto, non le sue dimensioni reali.

Models.metaTitle: Models: what easyrender runs on · easyrender
Models.metaDescription: The three models behind every easyrender render, the settings they run with and what each step costs in credits. A failed step is refunded.
Models.title: The models behind every render
Models.description: Three models, one after the other: the first draws a quick draft of your photo from every side for free, the second redraws it at full size when you build, and the third builds the 3D file from those drawings. Here is which, with what settings, and what each step costs.
Models.provider: All three models run on Replicate.

sheet.title: Draft sheet
sheet.role: Draws the object from eight sides plus a top view on one 1K sheet, from your photo and a short prompt. It is your free preview: you see it before anything is built.

settings.prompt: Prompt: a fixed turnaround brief, plus guidance for the product category and its material

final.title: Final sheet
final.role: When you build the 3D model, the sheet is drawn again at full size with the same brief, so the 3D build starts from sharper views.

settings.prompt: Prompt: the same turnaround brief as the draft

build.title: 3D build
build.role: Rebuilds a textured 3D model from your photo and the nine sheet views. The result downloads as GLB and USDZ.

pricing.title: What each step costs
pricing.build: Final sheet and 3D build, once the draft exists
pricing.note: The draft is free as a daily preview. A credit costs {unit} and never expires. If a step fails, its credits are refunded.

change.title: What can change
change.body: Prompts and model settings can be tuned without a release. The models and their prices are fixed in the app, so the credits on the button are what you pay.

Evals.metaTitle: Evals: how renders are checked · easyrender
Evals.metaDescription: How easyrender scores its own renders: the five criteria, the checks that run on every render, and the results of each published run.
Evals.title: How we check renders
Evals.description: Every render passes automatic checks before it is stored. Separately, a run renders a golden set of product photos and scores them against five criteria, so a change to a prompt or a model shows up as a number.

checks.title: Checked on every render
checks.description: These checks already run in production. A render that fails one is not delivered, and its credits are refunded.
checks.photo: Photo: at least {min} px on the short side, under {max} px on the long side, no wider than {aspect}:1 and not a flat colour. It is rejected before any model runs, so it costs nothing.
checks.sheet: Sheet: at least {side} px, the object visible in at least {cells} of the 9 cells, and no more than {repeats} of the 8 turnaround views repeated.
checks.file: 3D file: a complete GLB (binary glTF, version 2) of more than {kb} KB.

criteria.title: What a run scores
criteria.description: Each photo of the golden set is rendered with the live pipeline and scored on five criteria, pass or fail.

shape.title: Shape and proportions
shape.description: The model keeps the shape, proportions and parts of the photographed object, with nothing added or removed.

views.title: Eight different views
views.description: The eight turnaround views of the sheet are different pictures, and the object is in every cell.

material.title: Material realism

Analytics.title: Cookie e analisi
Analytics.banner: Google Analytics è facoltativo: puoi accettarlo o rifiutarlo. Usiamo anche PostHog senza cookie, che resta attivo indipendentemente da questa scelta.
Analytics.intro: Qui spieghiamo lo spazio di archiviazione del browser, Google Analytics facoltativo e la nostra analisi del prodotto senza cookie.
Analytics.anon: Questo cookie proprietario identifica le tue anteprime anonime, applica il limite gratuito giornaliero e ti permette di associarle al tuo account. Mantiene anche gli stessi prezzi durante un test dei prezzi, anche se rifiuti le analisi. Viene creato alla prima visita e dura un anno.
Analytics.consent: Ricorda la tua scelta, la data e la versione per un anno. Viene creato solo quando scegli.
Analytics.ga: I cookie di Google Analytics misurano le visite e durano fino a due anni. Nelle regioni più restrittive richiedono il consenso; altrove la misurazione è attiva salvo rifiuto o GPC. Quando consentito, er_campaign conserva i campi di campagna ammessi nello spazio di sessione per un massimo di 30 minuti e viene eliminato in caso di rifiuto. Gli acquisti confermati possono essere inviati dal server con la stessa identità di misurazione, anche senza tornare dal checkout. Archiviazione pubblicitaria e personalizzazione restano disabilitate.
Analytics.posthog: PostHog si carica in tutte le regioni, anche dopo un rifiuto o con GPC. Il suo SDK per browser non usa cookie né archiviazione persistente e non crea profili personali. Raccogliamo inoltre eventi server per registrazioni, rendering e pagamenti, associati a identificativi interni dell’account o dell’anteprima. Un identificativo di prezzo sottoposto a hash collega le visite ai prezzi con registrazioni e acquisti per misurare il test dei prezzi.
Analytics.attribution: I parametri della campagna e la pagina di provenienza restano in memoria e vengono salvati alla creazione di un’anteprima o di un account. Se Google Analytics è consentito, questi campi restano anche temporaneamente nello spazio di sessione, come indicato sopra. Non salviamo identificativi dei clic pubblicitari. Gli eventi operativi del server sono indipendenti dalla misurazione Google facoltativa.
Analytics.withdraw: Rifiuta interrompe Google Analytics facoltativo, elimina i suoi cookie e lo spazio di sessione er_campaign e richiede l’annullamento delle misurazioni degli acquisti ancora in attesa sul server per il tuo account connesso. GPC blocca Google Analytics facoltativo. PostHog senza cookie e gli eventi operativi del server restano attivi. Questo controllo non ritira i dati già inviati.

labels.emptyHelp: See Data sources & health for configuration and coverage.
labels.name: Dimension
labels.keysUsed: API keys last used in period
labels.creator: Creator
labels.postgresUnavailable: Postgres unavailable or analytics row limit exceeded
labels.posthogUnavailable: PostHog unavailable · visits are not measurable
labels.stripeUnavailable: Stripe unavailable or incomplete · using DB fallback
labels.profileDetails: Business type, store platform and self-reported catalog size need a profile question at signup (planned).
labels.periodDefinitions: Activation follows signups in the selected period through its end. Usage follows render creation; revenue follows payments. Previous means the immediately preceding equal-duration window. Current subscriptions have no historical comparison.
labels.mutableRenderTimes: Render completion and generation times are proxies: updatedAt also changes after completion; no immutable sheet completion timestamp exists. A sheet requires sheetKey; a model requires ready + glbKey.
labels.boundedSnapshot: Read-only snapshot, capped at 50,000 rows per table. Exceeding a cap stops the report rather than publishing partial totals.
labels.dbFallback: DB fallback (no Stripe fees/refunds/MRR from Stripe). Paid purchases use stored USD amounts for PAYG and subscriptions; only legacy subscription grants without a purchase link infer catalog prices. Net assumes no observable cash refunds. Dev grants are not revenue.
labels.anonymousTeamCaveat: Team exclusions apply to known account emails. Anonymous previews and cookieless traffic cannot reliably exclude the team.
labels.multipleCurrencies: Tables separate currencies. Charts show the first currency only; no FX conversion or cross-currency total is calculated. Provider margin is USD only.
labels.attributionScope: First-touch signup cohort and period payment activity. Visit joins use matching dimensions; missing traffic stays unknown. Signals require at least 20 signups.
labels.weeklyReading: Weekly reading: inspect campaign payers, UTM coverage and country mix. Signals are diagnostic, not experiment approval. Ad spend, CPC, platform clicks and the 14-day / budget gates need the external campaign tracker.
labels.visitsCaveat: Visits = landing_view; pageviews = $pageview. Unique visitors sum daily hash estimates, not distinct people across the period. Consent and blockers bias traffic; do not compare markets as equal coverage.
labels.cohortDefinition: Each cell is cumulative conversion by the end of cohort week 0–8. Unfinished weeks are blank. Revenue is gross in the first displayed currency through the selected end.
labels.anonymousLink: anonId + userId proves a claimed preview, not signup conversion: startBuild/startSheet assigns ownership after signup. A trustworthy anonymous-preview → signup rate needs a signup-time link.
labels.reconciliationScope: DB excludes team by default; PostHog includes all events. Sheet counts use creation-time proxies, model counts updatedAt; event timestamps and snapshot state can differ. Investigate differences; equality is not proof of correct tracking.
labels.healthNotes: Refresh invalidates database (5 min) and external-source (10 min) caches. Missing sources never become zero. Errors are sanitized; raw API responses and secrets stay server-side.
labels.stripeScope: Stripe payments without a known account are excluded with team filtering. Current subscriptions are filtered by customer identity. First-payer classification and LTV are bounded by fetched Stripe history.
labels.analyticsRowLimit: Analytics row limit exceeded · no partial totals are shown
labels.overviewPerDay: Visits, paying customers, uses & revenue per day
labels.overviewPerWeek: Visits, paying customers, uses & revenue per week
labels.overviewPerMonth: Visits, paying customers, uses & revenue per month
labels.overviewScale: Counts: square-root scale on the left to keep smaller series visible. Revenue: linear scale on the right. Toggle series to focus.
labels.payingDayHelp: distinct users who paid that day
labels.payingWeekHelp: distinct users who paid that week
labels.payingMonthHelp: distinct users who paid that month

connect.title: Give your agent a 3D tool.
connect.description: Use the easyrender MCP endpoint with your account. Choose your client below for its setup instructions.
connect.accountBody: Sign in or create an account to manage your API keys and credits. Use the same account to find your agent’s renders in your library.
connect.security: Use the sign-in flow where supported, or your own API key. Keep keys in your client configuration, never in shared prompts.

account.q: Do I need an easyrender account?
account.a: Yes. MCP requests are authenticated and renders belong to your account. The connector setup offers sign-in instructions for Claude and API-key configuration for the other listed clients.

input.q: Can my agent use a local photo?
input.a: create_render accepts a public HTTPS image URL or base64 image data. For a local photo, your client needs to read and send the file as base64. Supported types are JPEG, PNG and WebP, up to 4 MB.

payment.a: The angle-sheet preview is free, subject to preview limits. render_3d starts the paid build. Ask your agent to call get_credits for the current cost and to request your approval before building. That instruction is part of your agent workflow, not an extra confirmation screen enforced by the MCP server. Failed 3D builds refund their credits.

output.q: What does my agent get back?
output.a: The tools return a render ID, status and links to the render page, preview and GLB. Poll get_render until the model is ready before downloading. Private files require authentication; receiving a link does not make a render public.

scope.q: Is this a model library or a CAD tool?
scope.a: Neither. It generates an approximate model of the object in your photo. It does not provide a library of downloadable assets, exact measurements, manufacturing-ready geometry or automatic publication to your store.

api.q: How is MCP different from a REST API?
api.a: MCP exposes named tools that a compatible agent can discover and call in a conversation. You connect the server in your client instead of writing those tool integrations yourself. This page covers the MCP workflow.

workflow.title: You own the experience. We generate the model.
workflow.description: Three stages, with a clear boundary between the preview and the paid build.

photo.title: Upload and preview
photo.body: Send a JPEG, PNG or WebP file as multipart form data. Keep the returned render ID and check progress.

review.title: Approve the build
review.body: Show the preview and credit cost in your UI. Call the build endpoint only when you are ready to spend credits.

download.title: Retrieve the GLB
download.body: Poll for completion from your server, handle failures and download the finished model with your API key.

connect.title: Start with an API key.
connect.description: Create a key in Connectors, then make requests from your backend or terminal.
connect.accountBody: Sign in or create an account to manage API keys, buy credits and find generated models in your library.
connect.setupNote: Replace er_your_key with your key. Run the examples in the same shell. Keep the key on your server; never put it in browser or mobile client code.
connect.mcpTitle: Want to connect an AI agent instead?

examples.title: From the first request to a GLB.
examples.description: Copyable cURL examples for the current REST endpoints. Run each stage separately and wait for the required status.

upload.title: 01 · Upload your photo
upload.body: Use your own product.jpg. The response includes id, status and renderCredits. The image field is a file, not a JSON image_url.
upload.label: POST /api/renders

visibility.title: 02 · Choose visibility
visibility.body: Replace EASYRENDER_RENDER_ID with the id from the response. Finished renders are public by default. This request keeps the render out of the public gallery; send it before starting the build.
visibility.label: PATCH /api/renders/'{'id'}'

preview.title: 03 · Wait for the preview
preview.body: Repeat the first request with a delay until status is preview_ready. Then run the second request and inspect preview.webp. Use renderCredits from the JSON response to show the build cost. Stop if status is failed.
preview.label: GET status → GET preview

build.title: 04 · Start the paid build
build.body: This request spends credits. Run it only after reviewing the preview, confirming the cost and ensuring your account has enough credits. Your application must implement its own approval step.
build.label: POST /api/renders/'{'id'}'/render

download.title: 05 · Download when ready
download.body: Repeat the status request with a delay until status is ready and hasModel is true. Only then run the download request. A failed status ends the job; failed builds refund their credits.
download.label: GET status → GET model

examples.copyError: Clipboard unavailable. Select the code and copy it manually.
examples.polling: Use polling with a delay and a timeout in your application. These examples show individual requests, not an automatic retry loop. For HTTP errors, inspect the JSON error and code fields.

input.a: Send a JPEG, PNG or WebP file up to 4 MB in the multipart image field. An optional prompt adds notes about the object. Use a clear photo of one product; image quality checks may reject unsuitable inputs.

auth.q: Where should I use my API key?
auth.a: Send it as Authorization: Bearer from your backend. The key authorizes requests for your account, including paid builds. Do not expose it in a frontend bundle, a mobile app or shared example code. Manage and revoke keys in Connectors.

cost.q: How do I check the cost and my balance?
cost.a: Render responses include renderCredits, the total credit cost of a 3D build. GET /api/renders returns your library and balance. The preview has an allowance; a POST to the render endpoint starts the paid build. The pricing section below reflects the current plans.

errors.q: How should I handle progress and errors?
errors.a: Poll GET /api/renders/'{'id'}' with delays and a timeout. Wait for preview_ready before building and ready before downloading; stop on failed. HTTP 402 means insufficient credits, 409 an invalid build state, 413 an oversized image, 415 an unsupported image type and 429 an exhausted preview allowance. Do not blindly repeat upload or payment requests.

webhooks.q: Can my application receive a completion webhook?
webhooks.a: The public REST flow shown here uses polling. A customer-configurable completion webhook is not exposed by these endpoints. Use the status response to trigger the next step in your application.

scope.q: What kind of model does the API produce?
scope.a: A textured GLB representing the object in your photo. Geometry is approximate, without guaranteed real-world dimensions or manufacturing precision. This is generation from your own images, not a model library or a promise of automatic store publishing.

privacy.title: Informativa sulla privacy
privacy.metaDescription: Informativa sulla privacy — easyrender.ai. Il testo legale qui sotto è disponibile in inglese.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how easyrender.ai handles personal data when you use our website, apps, API and MCP tools to turn a photo into a 3D model. MRRAMOS INMUEBLES SL, the Spanish company identified above, is the data controller. Applicable data protection laws include the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on the Protection of Personal Data and Guarantee of Digital Rights (LOPDGDD) and, where applicable to UK users, the UK GDPR. Contact info@easyrender.ai about privacy or your rights.

collection.title: 1. Data we collect
collection.body: We collect account details (name, email, password hash and, if you choose Google sign-in, profile and authentication identifiers); session and API credentials; uploaded photos, prompts, previews, generated models and job history; credit balances, ledger entries, purchases, subscription status and Stripe references; and messages you send us. Stripe collects payment and billing details directly; we do not store your full card number. Technical data includes IP addresses or derived identifiers, browser and device information, request and error logs, approximate country, consent choices, referral and campaign information, and product usage events. Anonymous previews are associated with an anonymous browser identifier. Please avoid uploading people, personal documents, sensitive data or confidential material.

purposes.title: 2. Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body: The contract, legal obligation, legitimate interests and consent bases described below apply under the EU GDPR and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), and under the UK GDPR where it applies. We use account, upload and transaction data to provide the service you request, generate and deliver files, manage credits and subscriptions, and answer service requests (performance of a contract or steps requested before entering one). We retain required billing records and respond to valid legal demands to meet legal obligations. We use proportionate security, abuse prevention, diagnostics and cookieless product measurement for our legitimate interests in protecting and improving the service; you may object to processing based on those interests. Optional analytics use consent where required, including in the EEA. Where local law permits analytics without prior consent, we rely on legitimate interests and offer a rejection control. We do not use your data for decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects solely through automated processing.

public.title: 3. Uploads, AI processing and public models
public.body: AI providers process the photo, prompts and intermediate outputs needed to produce previews and 3D models. Generated models are public by default and may appear in the gallery, be viewed, downloaded, shared and indexed by search engines. Public model pages can also expose previews and source imagery. Use the available visibility controls before sharing sensitive content. Changing visibility does not revoke files already downloaded or copies held by others; file URLs and cached copies may remain accessible. Contact us to request removal. Do not upload material that you cannot lawfully share or send to our processing providers.

providers.title: 4. Service providers and other recipients
providers.body: We use Vercel for hosting, Neon/Postgres for account and application data, AWS S3 and CloudFront for file storage and delivery, Better Auth software and its hosted dashboard for authentication administration, Stripe for payments and subscriptions, Replicate and the AI model providers used by the rendering pipeline for image and model processing, PostHog EU for product measurement, Google Analytics 4 for optional analytics, and Sentry for error monitoring where enabled. Google also receives authentication data if you choose Google sign-in. Providers receive the data needed for their role and act as processors where applicable; payment and identity providers may also act as independent controllers for their own legal or security purposes. We may disclose necessary information to professional advisers, authorities when legally required, or a successor in a business transfer subject to applicable safeguards. We do not sell personal data.

transfers.title: 5. International transfers
transfers.body: MRRAMOS INMUEBLES SL is established in Spain. Your data may be processed in or accessed from Spain and other countries where our providers or their subprocessors operate, including the United States, outside the EEA and the United Kingdom. EU hosting does not exclude overseas support access or onward transfers. Transfers subject to the EU GDPR require an applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, unless a permitted statutory exception applies. Safeguards may include the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses, with transfer risk assessments and additional measures where required. Where the UK GDPR applies to a transfer, safeguards may include the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or UK Addendum. You can request details of the safeguards applicable to your data and copies, subject to redaction of confidential details, at info@easyrender.ai.

retention.title: 6. Retention and deletion
retention.body: Account information and saved uploads, previews and models are retained while needed to provide your account and library, or until a deletion request is handled. Uploads and outputs do not have a promised automatic expiry. Transaction and credit records may be kept after account closure for applicable accounting, tax, fraud prevention and legal claim requirements. Support, security and analytics records are retained according to their purpose, provider settings and applicable legal requirements; factors include whether an issue remains open, whether the data is still needed and whether a legal retention duty applies. Deletion requests are reviewed for those obligations. Backups and CDN caches may retain copies until their normal expiry; publicly downloaded copies cannot be recalled. Browser storage lifetimes are described on the cookie information page.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies, analytics and your choices
cookies.body: Essential storage supports sign-in, anonymous previews, language preferences and remembering your consent choice. PostHog uses its EU endpoint in cookieless, in-memory mode, with session recording and automatic interaction capture disabled. In the current implementation it runs independently of the optional analytics consent choice, and operational server events also continue after rejection. GA4 uses Consent Mode v2: analytics storage defaults to denied, and advertising storage, advertising user data and ad personalization remain denied. Optional GA4 measurement requires acceptance in strict-consent regions, including the EEA; in other supported regions it may run until you reject it. Global Privacy Control blocks optional GA4. You can change your choice on the cookie information page. Rejection stops optional GA4, removes its cookies and campaign session storage, and requests cancellation of pending server purchase measurement for your signed-in account. It does not retract data already sent or stop PostHog. Contact us to object to processing based on legitimate interests.

rights.title: 8. Your rights and complaints
rights.body: EU/EEA and UK users retain their rights under the EU GDPR and UK GDPR where applicable, subject to the conditions in those laws: access, correction, erasure, restriction and portability of personal data, and objection to processing based on legitimate interests. Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD) recognises the same rights for processing subject to Spanish law. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. Contact info@easyrender.ai; we may request proportionate identity verification. For GDPR and UK GDPR requests we normally respond within one month and explain any lawful extension; other requests are handled within the applicable statutory time limit. You may complain to the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD), the Spanish supervisory authority, or bring a claim before the Spanish courts. EU/EEA users may also complain to the supervisory authority where they live, work or believe an infringement occurred. Providing account and payment information is necessary for paid services; without it we cannot provide those features. Optional analytics consent is not required to use the service.

changes.title: 9. Security, children and policy changes
changes.body: We use access controls and technical safeguards appropriate to the service, but no system is completely secure. The service is intended for adults and we do not knowingly collect children’s data; contact us if you believe a child has supplied personal data. We may update this policy as the service or legal requirements change, show the revised date, and provide additional notice of material changes where required. A policy update does not itself grant new consent.

terms.metaDescription: Termini di servizio — easyrender.ai. Il testo legale qui sotto è disponibile in inglese.
terms.intro: Easy Render is a product operated by MRRAMOS INMUEBLES SL, the company identified above. These terms govern your use of easyrender.ai, its apps, API and MCP tools. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms. Contact info@easyrender.ai for service, billing or legal questions. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.

service.title: 1. The service and its limits
service.body: easyrender turns one photo of a single piece of furniture, decor object or building exterior into AI-generated previews and a 3D model, with GLB and USDZ downloads where available. Free angle previews are subject to usage and abuse-prevention limits. The service does not model whole interior rooms. Outputs are estimates: dimensions, scale, geometry, materials and resemblance are not guaranteed. Verify outputs before using them in commerce or other projects. They are not surveys, engineering drawings or a basis for structural, construction or safety decisions. Features described as coming soon are not included promises of current functionality.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts and access
accounts.body: You must be at least 18 and able to enter a binding contract, or act with authority for the business you represent. Provide accurate account and billing information, protect your password and API keys, and tell us promptly about unauthorized access. You are responsible for activity you authorize through your account and connected agents. Do not share credentials publicly, impersonate another person or bypass account restrictions. We may restrict access where reasonably necessary to address abuse, security incidents, non-payment or unlawful activity, and provide notice and a way to contact us where practicable.

credits.title: 3. Credits, prices and plans
credits.body: Paid generation uses credits. Current prices, included credits, currency, billing interval and applicable taxes are shown in the pricing interface and Stripe checkout before purchase. Pay-as-you-go purchases add credits; monthly plans renew and charge automatically until cancelled. Credits never expire and unused plan credits roll over. Credits are service units, not money, deposits or an investment. Manage, change or cancel your plan through the billing portal in Credits; the portal shows when a change or cancellation takes effect. Cancellation stops future renewals according to that confirmation and does not itself refund prior payments. Generation costs are shown before you spend credits. Future price or plan changes will be communicated as required by law and do not retrospectively change completed purchases.

refunds.title: 4. Failed jobs, refunds and consumer rights
refunds.body: When a charged rendering job fails, including a failed quality check, the credits charged for that failed job are returned to your credit balance. This is a credit reversal, not an automatic refund to your card. The service does not provide an automatic cash-refund flow. For a payment error, disputed charge, defective service or refund request, contact info@easyrender.ai with your purchase details. Nothing here excludes refunds or remedies required by law. EEA consumers generally have a 14-day withdrawal right for distance contracts, subject to statutory conditions and exceptions. Starting generation does not by itself waive that right: any exception for immediate digital supply requires the legally required express consent, acknowledgement and confirmation. To exercise a statutory withdrawal right, send us a clear statement identifying your account, purchase and decision to withdraw. Where applicable, the law determines any proportionate amount due for services expressly requested during the withdrawal period and the refund owed.

ownership.title: 5. Your content and intellectual property
ownership.body: You keep your rights in uploaded photos and other content. You must own those rights or have all permissions needed to upload, process and, where public, share that material, including relevant privacy, property, copyright and trademark permissions. You grant us a non-exclusive licence to host, copy, transmit and process your content through our service providers to operate the service, generate and deliver outputs, and display content you make public. This licence is limited to those purposes and necessary retention, legal and backup requirements. We do not claim ownership of your uploaded content. To the extent we hold transferable rights in outputs generated for you, we assign those rights to you, subject to third-party rights. AI outputs may not qualify for intellectual property protection, may resemble other outputs and are not guaranteed exclusive or free of third-party claims. Our software, branding and service remain ours or our licensors’.

public.title: 6. Public models and sharing
public.body: Generated models are public by default. Public model pages, previews and associated imagery may be listed in the gallery, indexed, shared and downloaded by others. Do not upload confidential material or content you lack permission to publish. Available visibility controls can remove public listing, but cannot recall earlier downloads, third-party copies or cached files, and existing file URLs may remain accessible. Contact info@easyrender.ai for removal requests. Publishing a model does not transfer your underlying intellectual property to other visitors or grant them an unrestricted commercial licence.

use.title: 7. Acceptable use
use.body: Do not use the service for unlawful, infringing, deceptive, abusive or exploitative content; non-consensual intimate imagery; sexual content involving minors; or activities that violate another person’s privacy or rights. Do not upload malware, attack or overload systems, evade limits or payment, scrape private data, or attempt unauthorized access. You must review outputs and use them lawfully. We may refuse or remove content and suspend access for violations, applying proportionate measures and complying with applicable notice and redress obligations. Report misuse or rights infringements to info@easyrender.ai.

availability.title: 8. Availability and ending the service
availability.body: We aim to provide a reliable service, but maintenance, provider outages and AI processing failures can interrupt it. We may change features or discontinue the service with reasonable notice where practicable and as required by law. You may stop using the service, cancel your plan through billing and contact us to close your account. Account closure is separate from subscription cancellation. On suspension or closure, access may end; outstanding payment obligations and provisions that by their nature survive will continue. We will handle unused paid entitlements and any refunds required by applicable law; this clause does not authorize forfeiture of statutory rights.

liability.title: 9. Responsibility and liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, the service and AI outputs are provided as available without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation or fitness for a particular purpose. For business customers, our aggregate liability arising from the service is limited to the amounts paid to us for the service in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim, and we exclude indirect or consequential losses, including lost profits. These limits do not apply to fraud, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or liability that cannot lawfully be limited. Consumer statutory guarantees, data protection rights and mandatory remedies remain unaffected. You remain responsible for the rights in your inputs and for verifying how you use outputs.

law.title: 10. Changes, governing law and disputes
law.body: These terms and related non-contractual obligations are governed by Spanish law. The courts of Spain have jurisdiction over disputes concerning these terms, including their existence, validity, interpretation, performance, breach or termination. Before starting formal proceedings, both parties must seek a resolution through good-faith direct negotiation for at least 30 days after written notice of the dispute; send notices to info@easyrender.ai. If you are a consumer, these provisions do not deprive you of mandatory protections in your country of habitual residence or your right to bring claims before courts available under applicable consumer law, and do not delay remedies that mandatory law makes available to you. We may revise these terms, publish the new date and give notice of material changes as required. Changes apply prospectively and do not remove accrued rights. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply.
